It was the first confirmed footage of a colossal squid alive in its natural habitat, a century after the species was first identified. Despite its name, the squid was a juvenile only about 30 centimeters (1 foot) long. (schmidtocean.org)
It was filmed on March 9, 2025, about 600 meters (2,000 feet) below the surface off the South Sandwich Islands in the South Atlantic Ocean. (schmidtocean.org)
